text: Supports MUST be drawn before what rests on them, and a part sitting on another MUST declare rests.
Face details MUST lie in their face plane, inside the face, away from rounded corners.
Labels MUST sit in side columns at least 13 apart, NEVER overlap, and number at most 9 when revealed on hover or 5 when always shown.
Leader lines NEVER cross another solid without a written justification.
Shapes and label text MUST stay inside the viewBox.
Every fill and stroke MUST be var(--...), none or url(#...); NEVER a raw colour.
Every animation MUST stop under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Motion MUST move along one iso axis and NEVER lift in z while resting.
A figure MUST explain exactly one idea with one concrete object.
checklist: The idea is stated in one sentence and the object is a concrete thing a reader can picture.

text: Motion MUST tell one story and the still frame MUST explain the idea alone.
checklist: Motion tells one looping story and the reduced-motion still frame still explains the idea.

text: Copy MUST be one idea per sentence and NEVER claim facts the page does not keep true.
checklist: Labels are a few words, captions one or two sentences, and no self-unmaintained claims appear.

text: The page MUST work in light and dark, at 390px with no horizontal scroll, with no console errors.
checklist: Screenshots in light, dark and 390px show no horizontal scroll and the console is clean.

text: Dots MUST carry meaning and be named in a label or the copy; NEVER decorate solids.
checklist: Every dot on a solid is named in a label or the copy.

text: The moving part MUST be labelled.
Parts on one base MUST either touch (one joined structure) or be at least 4 apart, and span at least 30% of the base.
Every labelled part MUST carry face details that identify it: one, plus one per 8% of the drawing it covers, up to three.
Every detail MUST be a real feature of the real part, and the SVG is NEVER edited by hand after the engine rendered it.
checklist: Each detail in the parts table names a real feature, and the SVG equals the build script output.

text: The figure MUST start from the goal the user stated; a missing goal is asked for, NEVER invented.
checklist: The report quotes the user's request and the idea sentence derived from it.

text: Every labelled part MUST cover at least 3% of the drawing so it can be read.
The object MUST be drawn as full solid volumes; thin slabs alone NEVER stand for the object.
The parts the idea needs MUST be declared in requiredParts, drawn and labelled; a needed part is NEVER dropped to pass another check.
A part above the ground MUST rest on or touch another part; NEVER float.
Labels and leaders MUST stay hidden until their part is hovered, focused or tapped, then appear with motion; the page MUST name every part in a card so nothing depends on hover.
checklist: At rest the figure shows no labels or leaders; hovering or focusing each part reveals its label; every part has a card.

text: A labelled part MUST stay at least 40% visible; glass or one open side shows the inside.
Solids MUST have the material of the real thing, at least two in a figure of three or more solids.
The object MUST look like the real thing from outside, in its real materials, with light and shadow from the engine only; NEVER show only the machinery, and NEVER draw a shadow or highlight by hand.
checklist: The outside of the object is recognisable, and the SVG has no hand-drawn shadow or highlight.

text: Inside parts and contents MUST be drawn inside the body and marked inside; NEVER beside it.
The figure MUST carry at least twelve face details, three per labelled part and one per solid on average, and no large solid may be bare.
The reader MUST be able to turn the object through four views, and the back sides MUST carry their real features.
checklist: The turn buttons show four views and no view has a bare side that the real object does not have.

text: Outlines MUST be the engine's one hairline weight; NEVER a heavier stroke.
checklist: No stroke width is set by the build script.
